fields.label: Image Provider
fields.description: Registry this image is pulled from; supplies the host prefix and the pull credentials.

fields.label: Image Path
fields.description: Repository path and tag within the registry, e.g. 'vllm/vllm-openai:v0.11.0'. The registry host is prefixed automatically.

fields.label: Full Image
fields.description: Derived '<registry host>/<image path>' — the ref passed to the provider.
